name: Sarkhaza

source.note: The 2025 Monster Manual's Ancient Red Dragon (CR 24), read twice from aidedd.org on 2026-10-18, as Sarkhaza (The Warm Snow, docs/story/side_quests.md). Every number is the book's; XP 75,000 in her lair. What the story adds is on her sheet: the count's rivets through her wings (Wings Bound: no Fly Speed, the book's is 80 ft.), and the states her fight can put her in (`states`, turned on by an encounter: the chain and the keepers' grave-salt; owner 2026-10-19: no choking on a hauled-in collar, she has her breath from the start). The book gives a dragon no lair actions; hers are the cavern's own (the vents, the roof). Not in the engine: the Multiattack's two Rends and a Scorching Ray (she makes three Rends), Detect Magic and Scrying; Pounce's move provokes no Opportunity Attacks, like every legendary move here. Drawn with the draconic spirit's sprite at her own height.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.summary: Four times a day (five in her lair), a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: If Sarkhaza fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead. She can do this four times a day, or five times while she's in her lair.

traits.name: Wings Bound
traits.summary: Iron rivets through the bone hold her wings shut. She can't fly.
traits.text: Forty years ago the count drove iron rivets through the bones of Sarkhaza's wings, and the bone has grown round them. Her wings stay folded against her back: she has no Fly Speed.

chained.name: Chained
chained.summary: A chain from a collar at her throat runs into the rock. She can only crawl: Speed 20 ft., no climbing.
chained.text: A collar of black iron sits at the base of Sarkhaza's neck, and its chain runs back into the rock to the count's anchor. It lets her drag herself about her cavern, slowly: her Speed is 20 feet, and she can't climb.

grave_salted.name: Grave-Salted
grave_salted.summary: She ate the party's salted carcass: Slowed, one Rend on her turn, one legendary action a round.
grave_salted.text: The count's grave-salt sits in her like lead. She is slowed: her Speed is halved, she takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, she can't take Reactions, and on her turns she can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both. Her Multiattack makes one Rend, and she takes one legendary action a round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Sarkhaza makes three Rend attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray (level 3 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.summary: Claws and teeth hot as a forge's coals.
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: a 90-ft cone of fire; DC 24 Dex save, 26d6 Fire, half on a success.
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 91 (26d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Charisma, DC 23, +15 to hit: Command (level 2), Detect Magic and Scorching Ray (level 3) at will; Fireball (level 6) and Scrying once a day.
actions.text: Sarkhaza casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). At will: Command (level 2 version), Detect Magic, Scorching Ray (level 3 version). 1/Day Each: Fireball (level 6 version), Scrying.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.summary: Casts Command (level 2); not again until the start of her next turn.

options.name: Fiery Rays
options.summary: Casts Scorching Ray (level 3); not again until the start of her next turn.

options.name: Pounce
options.summary: Moves up to half her Speed and makes one Rend.

lair_actions.name: The Vents Answer
lair_actions.summary: Two foes she can see: a vent opens under each; DC 15 Dex save, 2d6 Fire, half on a success.
lair_actions.text: Forty years of her heat have cracked the floor of the mountain. The cracks under up to two creatures Sarkhaza can see blow out fire: each makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

lair_actions.name: The Roof Comes Down
lair_actions.summary: One foe she can see: the heat-cracked roof falls on it; DC 15 Dex save, 2d8 Bludgeoning and Prone, half on a success.
lair_actions.text: Sarkhaza heaves against her chain and the heat-rotten roof cracks. Rock falls on a creature she can see: it makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half the damage only on a success.

summary: An ancient red dragon who came through the mists forty years ago after a dead silver dragon's gold, and found the count waiting. Chained by the neck in a cavern under Mount Ghakis, wings riveted shut, kept starving on a heap of treasure, she has had forty years to grow hungry and patient and very angry. Her claws are hot as coals and her breath fills the cave.
